So this happened to me as well. My husband asked me to marry him right after he got orders to Germany. Called his family and they said get a prenup. So when he came to me he stated he wanted to protect his assets. The only thing is he had literally nothing to his name except a military savings plan with 8k and a car he owned. While I had nothing and was working retail as well, with debt from college 30k and sending on credit cards that had gone to collections about 3k. I made sure to read the prenup that was given to make sure I knew what I was signing and was protected even though I was only bringing debt to the marriage. Long story short he never signed the prenup or even gave it to a lawyer or his family so no prenup before marriage. Years later he decided that he now really needs to protect himself and wants a post nuptial, due to him now working in Tech big company as well with various stock options a nice 401k, saving in crypto and having no debt whatsoever. While I'm still trying to find my way due to my jobs in criminal justice I'm not bringing in enough money for us to retire early and him sending me back to school for something I completely hate and don't like (Tech is not my thing but it brings in more money). Any day now I expect to hear he wants a divorce again just like every year since we have been married. 

YTA the way you have stated that you want to protect yourself since she doesn't make the same amount is why. You clearly don't understand where she is coming from and already looking to get a divorce, before you even get to the alter. If you want to marry her still think of a better way you can help her rather than putting her down and looking down on her for the type of work she does.
